title: Source colimit and projection-pullback presentation
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(T_{et}))$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $m:A\to B$ a morphism of abelian groups. A global cohomology continuity presentation consists of a small cofiltered category $I$, a diagram $D:I\to\operatorname{Sch}$ of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps, a limiting cone $c$, a natural transformation $t:D\to T$ and a map $p:c.pt\to T$ with $c_i t_i=p$, and a functor $F:I^{op}\to\operatorname{Ab}$ with isomorphisms $e_i:F_i\cong H^n(D_i,t_i^{-1}K)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. The transitions of $F$ are the projection pullbacks, expressed by the derived adjunction unit, Leray comparison, and inverse-image composition isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. It also consists of a colimiting cocone on $F$ with vertex $A$, an isomorphism $B\cong H^n(c.pt,p^{-1}K)$, and equations saying that each source leg followed by $m$ is the projection pullback to $c.pt$ followed by the inverse of this last isomorphism. No colimit property of the target cocone and no invertibility of $m$ is included.
